account.email_admin: Only a superadmin can change the address of an account that has set its password; the account changes it in its own settings.
account.email_unverified: The account has no verified email address to send a reset link to. If it has not set its password yet, send its invitation again.
account.invite_no_email: An invitation needs the account's email address.
account.invite_or_password: Either type a first password or send an invitation, not both.
account.no_email: The account has no email address to send the invitation to. Add one first.
account.not_invited: The account has set its own password already; reset its password instead.
bots.bad_name: Give the bot a name of 1 to {max} characters.
bots.bad_owner: Choose one of the accounts the bot can be given to.
bots.bad_token_discord: That does not look like a Discord bot token (three parts separated by dots, from the Bot page of the Discord Developer Portal).
bots.bad_token_telegram: That does not look like a Telegram bot token (123456789:AA..., from @BotFather).
bots.in_use: {count} route(s) use this bot. Give them another bot or delete them first.
bots.required: kind, name and token are required.
bots.token_in_use: That bot is already in use by another account.
daemon.bad_key: The daemon refused the web's key: WEB_APP_KEY differs between the two.
daemon.no_answer_join: The logger daemon did not answer. The join may still have happened: preview the chat again to check.
daemon.not_ready: The Telegram client is not ready ({message}). Try again in a moment.
daemon.off: The logger daemon's API is not configured (WEB_TGLOGGERD_API), so this cannot be done from here.
daemon.timeout: Telegram did not answer in time. Try again.
daemon.timeout_join: Telegram did not answer in time. The join may still have happened: preview the chat again to check.
daemon.unreachable: The logger daemon is not reachable. Try again later.
dashboard.bad_period: period is one of minute, hour, 4h, day, week, month, quarter and year.
dashboard.bad_range: start and end are unix times (end may be now), start before end, none past the year 9999.
dashboard.range_too_long: A chart of this period covers at most {limit}. Move the start later.
email.bad: That is not an email address.
email.taken: Another account has that email address.
federation.bad_admin: Only admins can be given a federation.
federation.bad_cursor: The cursor is not one this service gave.
federation.bad_group: Group {id} is not a known group.
federation.default_fixed: The Default federation holds the groups in no other federation; its name and groups cannot be changed.
federation.description: A federation's description is at most {max} characters, without control characters other than newlines and tabs.
federation.malformed: The body must be a JSON object of name, description, group_ids and admin_ids.
federation.name: A federation's name is 1 to {max} characters, without control characters.
federation.search_long: The search text is at most {max} bytes.
federation.text_only: An admin of a federation changes only its name and description; its groups and admins are the superadmins'.
federation.too_many_groups: A federation holds at most {max} groups.
fetch.bad_answer: The daemon's answer could not be read.
fetch.gone: This file is no longer available on Telegram.
fetch.not_allowed: This account may not fetch files from Telegram.
fetch.timeout: Telegram is slow to send this file. The download goes on; try again shortly.
fetch.unavailable: The daemon is busy or not connected to Telegram. Try again shortly.
fwd.bad_channel: Enter the Discord channel ID (the numeric id, from Developer Mode, Copy Channel ID).
fwd.bad_federation: Choose one of the federations that hold the chat.
fwd.bad_owner: Choose one of the accounts the configuration can be given to.
fwd.bad_types: types is a non-empty list of: {types}.
fwd.bad_webhook: That does not look like a Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...).
fwd.bot_kind: That bot is not a {kind} bot.
fwd.bot_not_owned: A member forwards only through its own bots: give it both bots of the route first.
fwd.chat_kind: chat_kind is group for a group (a negative chat_id) and user for a private chat (a positive one).
fwd.d2t_required: discord_channel_id, chat_id, discord_bot_id, telegram_bot_id, types and enabled are required.
fwd.duplicate: That Discord channel already forwards to that Telegram chat.
fwd.federation_required: The chat is in several federations: choose the one the configuration belongs to.
fwd.in_use: This route has forwarded {count} message(s), which are still linked to it. Disable it instead of deleting it.
fwd.t2d_required: chat_id, chat_kind, webhook_url, types and enabled are required.
fwd.test_message: Test message from the tgloggerd Discord integration: the webhook works.
fwd.test_required: Give the id of a saved webhook or a webhook_url to test.
fwd.test_unreachable: Could not reach Discord. Try again later.
group.channels_only: Only a channel's member list can be hidden; a group's members see each other in Telegram.
group.superadmins_only: Only superadmins change a group's settings.
group.write_fields: The body must be a JSON object with hide_member_list (true or false).
join.already_member: The account is already a member of this chat.
join.approval_required: The chat's guard bot must approve the join. Finish it in a Telegram client logged in as the account.
join.banned: The account is banned from this chat, or the chat is private and not accessible to it.
join.declined: The chat's guard bot declined the join.
join.empty: Paste an invite link or a @username.
join.flood_wait: Telegram is rate-limiting the account. Wait a while before trying again.
join.flood_wait_hours: Telegram is rate-limiting the account. Try again in {n} hours.
join.flood_wait_minutes: Telegram is rate-limiting the account. Try again in {n} minutes.
join.flood_wait_seconds: Telegram is rate-limiting the account. Try again in {n} seconds.
join.joined: Joined. The chat is now logged, media included.
join.link_invalid: The invite link is invalid, expired or revoked.
join.not_a_group: That username belongs to a user or a bot, not a group or channel.
join.not_found: No public chat has that username.
join.request_sent: Join request sent. An administrator of the chat has to approve it; the chat is logged once they do.
join.too_long: That is too long for an invite link or a username.
join.too_many_chats: The account is in too many chats to join another.
link.bad: This link is not valid any more: it was used already, it expired, or a newer one replaced it.
lookup.bad_answer: The daemon's answer could not be read.
lookup.failed: The lookup failed. Nothing may have changed; check the user's page.
lookup.flood_wait: Telegram refused to remove the contact (flood wait). Nothing was changed.
lookup.not_a_contact: The logging account does not have this user as a contact, so there is nothing to look up.
lookup.not_found: Telegram does not know this user.
lookup.rate_limited: A lookup ran recently; Telegram limits contact changes, so the daemon allows one at a time with a pause in between. Nothing was changed.
lookup.restore_pending: The contact is removed and not added back yet. The daemon keeps it in its journal and adds it back as soon as Telegram lets it.
lookup.telegram_error: Telegram refused the change before anything was changed.
lookup.timeout: The contact was added back, but Telegram did not report the user's own name in time; nothing was stored.
lookup.unavailable: The daemon is busy or not connected to Telegram. Nothing was changed.
lookup.unsupported: The contact's note has formatting that could not be restored, so nothing was changed.
mail.admin_reset.body:
Hello {name},

An administrator reset the password of your account {username} on {site}, and every session of the account was signed out. Choose a new password here:

{link}

The link works once, until {expires}.
mail.admin_reset.subject: Choose a new password for {site}
mail.footer: This message was sent by {site} for the account {username}. Please do not reply to it.
mail.invite.body:
Hello {name},

An account named {username} was made for you on {site}. Choose its password here:

{link}

The link works once, until {expires}. If you did not expect this message, ignore it: nothing happens without the link.
mail.invite.subject: Your account on {site}
mail.notice.disabled.body:
Hello {name},

Your account {username} on {site} was disabled at {time}. It can no longer sign in, and its sessions were signed out.

If you think this is a mistake, ask an administrator.
mail.notice.disabled.subject: Your account was disabled
mail.notice.email_new.body:
Hello {name},

Since {time}, this is the email address of your account {username} on {site}. Password resets and security notices come here now.
mail.notice.email_new.subject: Your email address was changed
mail.notice.email_old.body:
Hello {name},

At {time}, the email address of your account {username} on {site} was changed from this address to {email}. Password resets and security notices no longer come here.

If you did not ask for this, tell an administrator at once.
mail.notice.email_old.subject: Your email address was changed
mail.notice.new_device.body:
Hello {name},

Your account {username} on {site} signed in from a device it had not used before: {device}, from the address {ip}, at {time}.

If this was not you, change your password and sign out the other sessions in your settings.
mail.notice.new_device.subject: Sign-in from a new device
mail.notice.password.body:
Hello {name},

The password of your account {username} on {site} was changed at {time}, and its other sessions were signed out.

If you did not do this, reset your password at once and tell an administrator.
mail.notice.password.subject: Your password was changed
mail.notice.role.body:
Hello {name},

The role of your account {username} on {site} was changed from {old} to {new} at {time}, and its sessions were signed out.
mail.notice.role.subject: Your role was changed
mail.off: Email is not set up on this server, so no link can be sent.
mail.reset.body:
Hello {name},

Someone asked to reset the password of your account {username} on {site}. If it was you, choose a new password here:

{link}

The link works once, until {expires}. If it was not you, ignore this message: your password stays as it is.
mail.reset.subject: Reset your password on {site}
mail.verify.body:
Hello {name},

Confirm that this is to be the email address of your account {username} on {site}:

{link}

The link works once, until {expires}. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.
mail.verify.subject: Verify your email address for {site}
mcp.already_exposed: That group is already exposed. Edit its note instead.
mcp.bad_owner: Choose one of the accounts the token can be given to.
mcp.group_required: group_id is the group's (negative) chat id.
mcp.name_required: A token needs a name of 1 to 64 characters, so it can be told apart and revoked.
mcp.note_required: note is the new note, 0 to 255 characters; an empty one clears it.
mcp.scope_bad_entry: The scope entry {kind} {id} names nothing that can be read: a federation by its id, a group you can see by its (negative) chat id, or a private chat by the user's id.
mcp.scope_private_owner: A private chat can only be given to a token a superadmin owns.
mcp.scope_private_superadmins: Only superadmins give a token a private chat.
mcp.scope_too_long: A token's scope holds at most {max} entries.
notice.email: Your email address was changed (sent to the old and the new address)
notice.new_device: Someone signed in from a new device or browser
notice.password: Your password was changed or reset
password.weak: The new password must be at least 8 characters.
pins.limit: At most {max} groups can be pinned; unpin one first.
prefs.invalid: The value of {key} is not one it takes.
prefs.malformed: The body must be a JSON object of preferences.
search.limit: At most {max} searches can be saved; delete one first.
search.title: A saved search needs a title of at most 128 characters.
search.url: A saved search must be a path on this site, of at most 2048 bytes.
throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
